what: Gilberto Lerena Lenguas - his parents and siblings
detail: DONE 13 Sep 2026, and it no longer needs David or a CAPTCHA. His brother Luis Lerena Lenguas married at San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, on 19 December 1864, and that act names their parents outright: "hijo legitimo de Don Luis y de Dona Justiniana Lenguas". So Gilberto's parentage is documented from a primary act rather than from Geneanet. His siblings remain SECONDARY, from the FamilySearch Tree. ORIGINAL NOTE: Both sit behind bot checks this archive does not solve. One minute each for a person. The only question worth asking of him: was there a JUAN CARLOS in that family?

what: The other three genetic groups
detail: Five of eight are legible. If a Ligurian or Italian group is among the last three, the Italian hypothesis changes again. One scroll.

what: Read the baptism act: Rosario, Libro 15, folio 229 (1866)
detail: DONE the same day. Act 1541, image ark 3:1:S3HT-XS9C-ZL. The parents are Don Luis Lerena Lenguas and Dona Julia Juanico, "naturales del E. Oriental" - both Uruguayan. See notes/the-uruguayan-turn.md.

what: Search the Montevideo parish registers for Juan Carlos Lerena
detail: DONE 13 Sep 2026. The indexed Uruguayan record holds no Juan Carlos Lerena born 1830-1870; full text returns two hits for the phrase in the whole corpus, neither ours; and the one documented Lerena household of that generation - Luis Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico - has now been opened from the marriage act to the last burial. All four of their children are named, and he is not among them. ORIGINAL NOTE: "Uruguay, Registros Parroquiales, 1750-1930" on FamilySearch. A baptism in the 1840s-1850s and a marriage to a Maria before 1882. Opened by the 1866 Rosario act, which says the only Lerena in that parish was a native of the Estado Oriental.

what: Find Luis Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico in Montevideo
detail: DONE 13 Sep 2026. Married 19 December 1864, San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo, act 258 - image read at full resolution. He is named as the legitimate son of Don Luis and Dona Justiniana Lenguas, which makes the Montevideo trunk PRIMARY where it had been a tree assertion. She is named as the daughter of Dr Don Candido Juanico and Dona Juliana Gonzalez. ORIGINAL NOTE: Their marriage, and his own baptism. If his father is the Don Luis Lerena who stood godfather by proxy in 1866, that is two generations from one act.

what: Turn the Montevideo marriage-dispensation register, 1856-1932
detail: *** MARKED "done" IN ERROR, and corrected 13 September 2026. The task is to TURN the register, and turning is not searching. *** What was actually done was a FULL-TEXT search on the register's own formulae, and it answered well: eight Lerena dispensations in seventy-six years, two families - the Montevideo patricians of the Catedral and the rural Lerenas of Trinidad in Flores - NO Juan Carlos Lerena, and no Lerena-Lerena dispensation at all. But full text is machine handwriting recognition, and the whole reason to turn a register by hand is to catch what it misses. Still to do. *** The method is now proved - /search/film/<DGS>?i=<N>, ark from the page title, assemble the tiles - and only the DGS is missing; *** three routes to it failed on 13 Sep because FamilySearch's catalogue, records and full-text search were all erroring that day.

what: Open the CEMLA manifest for the four LERINA arrivals of 15 March 1889
detail: The exclusion of Laurensa, Savina, Anna and Annunziata LERINA was narrowed on 13 Sep 2026 - they are excluded on their dates, not on a judgement about the surname - but the manifest page itself has never been seen. CEMLA's search lives at search.cemla.com and is gated by a CAPTCHA (field "CaptchaCode"), which this archive does not solve. Ship ADELAIDE LAVARELLO from Genova, arriving Buenos Aires 15 March 1889. NOTE BEFORE SPENDING TIME ON IT: CEMLA's public search returns INDEX ROWS, not images. If it offers no page image, the manifest itself is at the Archivo General de la Nacion and this cannot be closed online at all.

what: Find the death of Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas
detail: *** DONE 13 September 2026: HE DIED 24 DECEMBER 1901, *** at seven in the morning at calle Suarez No. 25, el Paso del Molino, Montevideo - certificate 216, image read. "De nacionalidad oriental, nacido en Montevideo, de cincuenta y seis de edad, de estado casado, y de profesion HACENDADO", of pulmonary tuberculosis. His mother Justiniana Lenguas was alive at 79 and in the house. *** IT WAS HIDING UNDER A MISSPELLING: *** FamilySearch indexes him as Luis SERENA Lenguas, so every search on the surname missed him, including a 1,502-row sweep of Montevideo Lerena deaths run the same morning. Found by searching his MOTHER instead. Two things this row used to say were wrong: the window did NOT start in 1880 - his last child Candido Jaime was born 13 September 1884 - and the search was not blocked, it was looking under the wrong letter.

what: Three FamilySearch searches this session cannot run - two minutes in your own browser
detail: *** THE BLOCK IS OVER, and all three searches were run here on 13 September 2026. *** This row used to say FamilySearch had firewalled this automated session and that every request was refused on contact - true when it was written, false since, and left standing it would stop the next person from trying. (1) LUIS EUGENIO'S DEATH: found, 24 December 1901, act 216, image read. (2) JULIA JUANICO'S BAPTISM: found, born 23 November 1842, christened 4 October 1843 at San Francisco de Asis, mother given in full as Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez. (3) CANDIDO JUANICO'S FIRST MARRIAGE: the two-wives inference is confirmed from the children themselves - Julia born 1842 to Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez, against Sara, Zara and Celia born 1866-69 to SIXTA LENGUAS - though the marriage act itself is still not opened.

what: Put the ark on the last row that says IMAGE READ
detail: *** FOUR OF THE FIVE ARE RECORDED. *** Julia Juanico and her godfather Enrique (act 405, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NLLP), Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez (same act plus act 1720), and BARTOLOME LLERENA - re-opened and checked line by line, ark 3:1:S3HT-XK5S-TP, "Llerena / Bartolome / 45" with the double L. A TRAP FOUND ON THE WAY: the film's own ?i=86 is NOT the page this archive recorded as image 86; it lands on an Aguirrebarrena household with no Llerena on it. The ark came from his index record instead, which is the reliable route. *** THE ONE STILL MISSING IS EMA SIXTA LERENA JUANICO *** - La Union marriage register act 90, 30 June 1913. Two rounds of searching on 13 and 14 September failed: searching her with MASSERA as spouse returns only her CHILDREN'S records, and searching Jose Pedro Massera for 1912-14 returns passenger lists and index cards with no image ark. The act is almost certainly not name-indexed at image level. *** WHAT WOULD WORK: browse the La Union marriage register film directly by DGS *** - which needs the FamilySearch catalogue, and the way in is the DIRECT CATALOGUE ID rather than its search box. See data/rosario-films.tsv for that trick.

what: Open the images behind Gilberto Lerena Lenguas's parentage
detail: *** DONE 13 September 2026, and it came out primary. *** Act No. 1447, San Francisco de Asis, folio 504, 31 October 1886 - image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-Z9RM-W, read at DeepZoom level 12. It baptises Gilberto's daughter Maria Angelica Julia, "hija legitima de Don Gilberto Lerena y de Dona Julia Salvanach, orientales", and names the paternal grandparents "Don LUIS y Dona JUSTINIANA LENGUAS" - the couple named as Luis Eugenio's parents in his marriage act of 1864 and his death act of 1901. *** THE GODMOTHER IS DONA JULIA JUANICO DE LERENA, Luis Eugenio's own wife. *** It also produced two new people: Don Cristobal and Dona Angela Alvarez, Julia Salvanach's parents. THE SECOND IMAGE (ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BQZD-W, the baptism of Raul Alfredo Luis) is still unopened, and is worth opening as a second witness.

what: Read the six LORENAS of the 1869 Rosario census at their own pages
detail: Agustin (b.1829), Guillermo (1853), Geronima (1854), Mercedes (1860), Feliz (1866) and Maria (1868) LORENA are in the 1869 national census at Rosario, elsewhere in the film from Bartolome Llerena. *** Guillermo and Geronima are the right age to be a parent of a child born in 1882. *** The schedule will show household structure - who is head, who is spouse, who is child - and whether the clerk wrote Lorena, Lerena or Llerena.

what: Find the DGS for the Montevideo marriage-dispensation register
detail: *** TRIED AGAIN 13 September 2026 AND STILL BLOCKED - by their outage, not by the work. *** FamilySearch's CATALOGUE SEARCH and FULL-TEXT SEARCH were both returning "Something Went Wrong" for hours, while name-indexed records search and DIRECT CATALOGUE IDs worked normally. The dispensations are in the FULL-TEXT corpus, not a name-indexed collection, so full text is the only route to them - and it is the half that is down. *** WHAT WOULD UNBLOCK IT: *** the catalogue entry for the Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, opened BY ID rather than by search, which is how five other film DGS numbers were recovered today while search was dead.

what: Open the Confirmaciones film that covers Pablo Armando
detail: *** DGS 4531018, Confirmaciones 1883-1918, 421 images, UNRESTRICTED - recovered 13 September 2026. *** Born February 1882, he would have been confirmed in the 1890s, and a confirmation act commonly names the parents. This is a register this archive has listed as untried since the first week and never had a film number for. It was opened in the viewer that day but served NO image tiles and put no ark in the page title, unlike every other film handled here - so it needs another attempt rather than another search.
